basics.name: Maurin Schickli
basics.label: Software Engineer for AI Products - Vice World Champion in Industry 4.0
basics.summary: Software engineer focused on AI-assisted products, agentic workflows, and industrial platforms, with hands-on experience in AI chat, retrieval-driven knowledge access, MCP servers, and IoT systems.

work.name: Bühler Group
work.description: Worked on Bühler Insights and internal AI products that help employees and customers access knowledge and operate machines more cost-effectively.
highlights: Helped develop Bühler's internal AI chat solution with Next.js, used by over 5'000 people each month.
Planned and implemented a Dashboard Agent for Bühler Insights by identifying useful APIs and defining tools and parameters, helping customers get more value from their machine dashboards.
Built a retrieval-driven knowledge extension for Bühler Chat as my apprenticeship final project, enabling users to query selected SharePoint documents and share personas with attached context.
Led a Gen AI workshop for employees from our ecommerce product area, where we rebuilt part of the shopping experience inside the ChatGPT app.
Contributed to various internal hackathons where we built, for example, an MCP server for live PLC variable access so AI agents could debug PLC code with better machine context.

education.institution: GBS Gewerbliches Berufs- und Weiterbildungszentrum St. Gallen

awards.title: Vice-World-Champion in Industry 4.0
awards.summary: Competed against top professionals nationwide and worldwide together with my teampartner to create IoT-enabled smart systems with features like alerts, image recognition, and database integration.

projects.name: @agent for GitLab
projects.description: Built an agent workflow for GitLab that reacts to mentions, runs securely inside CI pipelines, and can search, edit, commit, and reply back through MCP-enabled integrations. The project sharpened my understanding of agent execution, tooling, and production-minded developer workflows.

projects.name: Knowledge-Enabled Personas
projects.description: For my apprenticeship final project, I added a retrieval-driven knowledge layer to Bühler Chat so users could query selected SharePoint documents and share reusable personas with pre-attached document context. The focus was making internal knowledge easier to use in AI-assisted workflows.

projects.name: query-layer
projects.description: I built this to experiment with Durable Objects and AI agents for fast, retrieval-driven knowledge access. It provides a simple interface to add data and query it with LLMs. The project helped me understand how to build AI-assisted products with a strong focus on performance and the importance of simple but powerful tools for an agent.
